segments.text: We almost closed the company. It was the hardest week of the year.
We had built a product without speaking to a single customer.
So we stopped coding for a week and started asking questions.
One teacher told us she needed feedback for her students immediately.
We built a tiny demo that same evening and showed it to her.
The next morning she asked when she could use it in her class.
The lesson was simple. We needed to listen before we built anything.
